reading: Both State and Observation have one constructor; support already exhausts their types. Added support_nodup and off-support-zero proofs change no mass value. pointMassAmbiguity still computes Shannon entropy zero from a unit predicted state and unit observation. Fixture and adapter expected scalars 1, 1, 0 agree. No theorem premise changed.
exit-convention: Positive 0 iff receipt, fixture and Lean pass. Negative mutates expected entropy 0 to 1 in memory; 0 iff baseline valid and fixture mismatch detected; 1 invalid baseline; 2 slipped mutation.
